name: Wrath of Mordred

facts.text: 40,000 health, immune to crowd control; its blows carry a Heat proc.
Mordred is Arthur's son or nephew in the legends, who fell with him at Camlann.

story: Mordred betrayed Arthur and died by his hand at Camlann, and the bards say his rage did not die with him. It went looking for somewhere to burn. The hill-folk of Llyn Barfog say it found the lake Arthur once cleansed of its monster and settled there to spite him, on a stretch of ground that has been scorched ever since. The Wrath of Mordred is not Mordred. It is only his anger, standing up, and every blow it lands carries a little of the fire of Camlann.
legend: Every hit burns: it has a fire proc on its melee, so the tank wants heat resist and steady heals. No crowd control works on it. It is Albion's oldest grudge, so finish it. The scorched ground marks where it stands.

phases.text: Camlann was not the end of it!

lairEntry: Scorched earth. A traitor's anger still burns.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: The Wrath of Mordred is spent. Camlann is over.
